newsitem.title: LEBANON: Troops deploy in Lebanese capital.
newsitem.headline: Troops deploy in Lebanese capital.

text.p: Lebanese army troops began deploying in Beirut on Wednesday ready to prevent planned anti-government demonstrations on Thursday, witnesses said.
A Reuters reporter saw troops in armoured personnel carriers deploying in west Beirut's Hamra commercial district.
Truckloads of troops drove past the Reuters office in the city and other units were seen in other parts of the capital.

Earlier, Interior Minister Michel al-Murr said opposition demonstrations planned during a general strike on Thursday were banned and the army and security forces were responsible for maintaining order.
